mutations.name: the open-PR check reads only heads, so a stacked child's base is deleted under it
kills: delete-branch op refuses a branch a stacked child PR targets as its base

mutations.name: the tip is not compared, so a branch pushed since the owner confirmed is deleted
kills: delete-branch op answers moved with the current tip when the branch moved since the owner confirmed, and deletes nothing

mutations.name: an absent branch reads already whoever deleted it
kills: delete-branch op answers gone for an absent branch this record did not delete

mutations.name: a prefix match ignores case, so Scratch/ passes as scratch/
kills: delete-branch op refuses %s, which carries no allowed prefix
